title: Candidate A Option-3 Reconstruction Protocol v1 — Draft Amendment 2: Source Regularization and Outer Truncation
motivation: Validation run results/candidate_a_option3_sensitivity_validation_2026-11-04.json found non-decaying outer HI/stellar profiles in 11/20 real THINGS galaxies (outer_exponential_tails variant failure) and negative Abel-inverted 3D bulge densities in IC2574 and NGC2403.
Until physically reviewed and formally signed off, real-data fitting remains unauthorized under Candidate A Option-3.

bulge_regularization.method: Pool-Adjacent-Violators Algorithm (PAVA) non-increasing projection on the clipped inner excess Sigma_bulge(r) prior to Abel inversion.
bulge_regularization.guarantee: Enforces dSigma_bulge/dr <= 0 pointwise so the Abel integral rho_bulge(r) >= 0 everywhere.

outer_support_truncation.scope: Non-decaying measured outer rings where mean d ln Sigma / d r >= 0.
outer_support_truncation.policy: Truncate smoothly or at fixed half-ring outer cutoff instead of unnormalizable positive-slope exponential extrapolation.
